10174.html:
10174 múkhya 'pertaining to face or mouth' AV., 'chief' TS. [múkha-]
    WPah.bhad. mukh, pl. mukkhā̃ n. 'end (of a beam, ladder, &c.)'; — altern. (and more prob.) < múkha- with expressive doubling: Ash. Wg. muk 'face', Kt. myuk, mīk, Pr. mikh, Dm. muk, Paš. mūkh m., Gaw. Bshk. muk, Sv. mukhá, Sh. mŭkh m. 'face' (koh. 'cheek'), K. mŏkh m. — Pa. mukkhaka- 'foremost, chief'; Aś.kāl. mukha- 'important', kb. rdh. mukhya-, top. mukha- m. 'chief official'; Pk. mukkha- 'chief'; N. mukhiyā 'village headman'; H. mukhyā 'chief'.
    maukhya-.
    *mugga- 'dumb' see mū́ka-.
    Addenda: múkhya-: WPah.kṭg. múkkhiɔ 'chief'.
